# Frictionborn Motion

> Frictionborn Motion is a library of verified motion and WebGL UI components built for React 19 and Next.js 16, engineered for zero visual slop, static server rendering, and zero-idle resource usage.

## Core Principles
- **Server Output is Static**: No opacity: 0 or transforms in server HTML. Hidden-before-reveal CSS only under [data-motion="ok"].
- **Single Frame Loop**: All components use useFrame from @frictionborn/runtime. Direct requestAnimationFrame is forbidden.
- **Strict WebGL Leases**: Max 4 WebGL contexts active per page. WebGL code is dynamically loaded only when in view and lease granted.
- **Reduced Motion is Architectural**: Mode is declared and verified (static, still-frame, opacity-only, or off).

## Components
- **magnetic-button**: cta: Magnetic spring wrapper for buttons and links with fine-pointer gating (dom, server-safe, <2.5 KB, reduced motion -> static, mobile -> 0 listeners) (Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @frictionborn/magnetic-button`)
- **marquee**: strip: Infinite marquee with inert duplicate, hover/focus pause, and WCAG pause button (dom, server-safe, <2.5 KB, reduced motion -> static, mobile -> ok) (Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @frictionborn/marquee`)
- **noise-field**: background: WebGL2 domain-warped noise hero background (webgl2, client-only, ~4.5 KB, reduced motion -> static poster, mobile -> tier 2 / tier 1 poster) (Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @frictionborn/noise-field`)
- **scroll-reveal**: media: Scroll-driven entrance using view-timeline with pooled IntersectionObserver fallback (dom, server-safe, <2 KB, reduced motion -> static, mobile -> 12px) (Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @frictionborn/scroll-reveal`)
- **text-reveal**: headline: Typography reveal by word/line/char with font-ready splitting (dom, server-safe, <3 KB, reduced motion -> static, mobile -> reduced stagger) (Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @frictionborn/text-reveal`)

## Runtime Usage
```tsx
import { MotionReadyScript, useFrame, useReducedMotion } from "@frictionborn/runtime";
```
